title.en: Chapter 9 — The Whistle in the Dark

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قعدنا بالأوضة بالعتمة وما حكينا ولا كلمة.
sentences.en: We sat in the room in the dark and did not say a word.

sentences.ar: ساعات مرقت وأنا بسمع دقات قلبي.
sentences.en: Hours passed and I could hear my own heartbeat.

sentences.ar: فجأة، سمعنا صوت خفيف زي مي بتغلي.
sentences.en: Suddenly, we heard a light sound like water boiling.

sentences.ar: هولمز أشعل الضوء وضرب الحبل بعصايته.
sentences.en: Holmes struck a light and beat the rope with his stick.
We heard a scream from the other room.

sentences.ar: لقينا زوج أمها ميت والحية ملفوفة على راسه.
sentences.en: We found her stepfather dead with the snake coiled on his head.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: كان بده وراثتها، والحية رجعت عليه.
sentences.en: Holmes said: he wanted her inheritance, and the snake turned back on him.
